finding: All repeated calls hit HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests). The Nemotron free tier has severe rate limits that make variance characterization impractical without long delays between calls (minutes).
implications: Backend variance cannot be characterized on the free tier with repeated calls
The main experiment succeeded because calls were spaced out across different tasks
For proper variance characterization, use a paid tier or a local model
From the main experiment, we observed that identical requests (A1/R1 step 0 on controls) produced the same actions in 38/40 control tasks, suggesting low action-level variance

indirect_evidence_from_main_experiment.note: This suggests P(action instability | identical request) is low for Nemotron, but cannot be quantified precisely from the main experiment because A1/R1 packets diverge after step 0

recommendation: Use a paid OpenRouter tier or local model for proper variance characterization in the confirmation phase
